name: The Everstill Bridge
label: Quest
description: The Everstill Bridge is a rebuilding effort led by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire to repair the town's damaged stone bridge. Progress has ground to a halt…
intro: The Everstill Bridge is a rebuilding effort led by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire to repair the town's damaged stone bridge. Progress has ground to a halt because iron meant for the project was redirected into weapons during the last orc invasion, and the replacement caravan from Stormwind was ambushed by Redridge gnolls.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor. We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.
Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt. If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, friend, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work, friend. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
